$comment: Single source of truth for tier -> model routing in omp-dev-team. The `model-routing` extension and the /model-routing-check command read this file. Agents declare a tier in their `model:` frontmatter: small/pattern agents use the `pi/smol` role (resolved by .omp/config.yml modelRoles.smol -> a cheap CLOUD model); balanced/deep agents pin a concrete cloud model id. The small tier is a CHEAP-CLOUD high-volume tier (it replaces the expensive Sonnet/Opus calls for lexical/structural checks), not a local-GPU tier.

small.rationale: Lexical/structural pattern matching, checklist-style verification (naming, complexity, a11y, svelte, js-fp, token-efficiency, claude-setup, progress-guardian). Cheap, high-volume, parallel. Routed to whatever modelRoles.smol points at -- a cheap cloud model (default claude-haiku-4-5; with the copilot-preset plugin, e.g. github-copilot/gpt-5-mini).

balanced.rationale: Semantic analysis with balanced cost/quality (most team agents + most review agents + orchestrator).

deep.rationale: Cross-file reasoning, high-stakes design synthesis, threat modeling, broad reconnaissance (security-review, domain-review, arch-review, architect, security-engineer, codebase-recon).

effortBand.$comment: Effort-band routing: the model is derived from the TASK SIZE (from the task-size-classifier, recorded by /scope in plan-gate state), not only from the agent's static tier. The agent's declared tier is the BASE band; the task size shifts it along the ladder. More deterministic than one-model-per-agent, and ties model spend to the work. Resolution: idx = clamp(ladder.indexOf(base) + effort[size].shift, 0, len-1); a `base` in `protectDownshift` never shifts DOWN (safety agents). copilot-preset is unaffected — the shift picks a tier, then modelRoles resolves the model.

trivial.note: no-plan fast path — downshift to save tokens (except protected bases)

standard.note: use the agent's declared base band

complex.note: upshift the implementer and reviewers for quality

effortBand.$enforcementNote: advisory: the extension logs + warns on a dispatch whose tier != the effort-band tier (the orchestrator applies the rule). Set env DEV_TEAM_EFFORT_ROUTING=enforce to upgrade the warning to a block, or =off to disable the band entirely (pure static tiers).

notes: Keep the high-volume `small` tier on the cheapest capable model to limit token spend; reserve balanced/deep for work that needs them. Pair with the copilot-preset and token-diet plugins for further cost control.
